title: Refuse an unhandled dispatch kind instead of resolving the advisor slot
action: Per D2 (store 06e49368), close the second silent-resolve site. slot_for_kind (prepare.rs:34-40) ends in a catch-all `_ => advisor`, so any kind without its own arm resolves the ADVISOR slot. Today that is unreachable by a typo because kind is enum-gated against DISPATCH_KINDS at prepare.rs:1358 and again at :647 — so this is a latent hazard, not a live bug, and the cap must say so rather than claim a fix to a live defect. Replace the catch-all with explicit arms plus a typed refusal for anything unhandled, so a kind added later cannot silently route work to the advisor model. Deliberately independent of mrs-2 and mrs-3: it touches only prepare.rs and may run beside them once mrs-1 has landed.

truths: No dispatch kind resolves the advisor slot except an explicit advisor arm
An unhandled kind produces a typed refusal naming its remedy, not a silent resolution
Existing behavior for cell, gather, reviewer and advisor is unchanged
